data.rationale: The proposal covers only the tail of the true workflow (date click, search, rooms/guests, filters/sort) and omits opening hotel search, entering and selecting the destination, and the first date. It has no parameters, and it hardcodes the literal "2" date, so a browser automation couldn't be built from it to search other locations, dates, guests or filters.
